summary.oneLiner: Eco Hotels And Resorts Limited is pioneering India’s first net-zero premium value hotel brand with a strict vegetarian philosophy, targeting high-growth Tier II/III cities through an asset-light EBOT™ model that combines 3D volumetric construction, AI-driven operations, and guaranteed investor returns — positioning it to capture the $100B+ sustainable tourism wave driven by spiritual, wellness, and eco-conscious travel demand.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Positions as a premium-value hotel chain targeting the underserved Midscale & Sub-midscale segments across Tier 1, 2, and 3 Indian cities, addressing a lack of standardization and quality assurance in that segment.
- Differentiates through a Veg/Vegan-focused 'Satva' brand philosophy rooted in ethical, spiritual & ecological values, combined with a broader sustainable/net-zero hospitality positioning.
- Operates an asset-light Strategic Business Model combining Leasing, EBOT, and Management Contracts to optimize regional demand-supply and operational efficiency rather than owning real estate outright.
- Backed by promoter group Red Ribbon Asset Management PLC, a UK-based impact investor with a diversified portfolio across UK, Gibraltar, Mauritius & India, providing access to global capital and fund-management relationships.

segment_detail.title: Segment / subsidiary detail
segment_detail.body: THE ECO™ (mid-premium, 30-65 keys, INR 2,500-4,500/night); THE ECO GRAND™ (premium, 65-100 keys, INR 3,500-7,499/night); ECOVALUE™ (budget, 15-35 keys, INR 1,500-3,500/night); ECOXPRESS™ (transit, 40-100 keys, INR 1,500-3,500/night); all brands feature 100% vegetarian dining via SAHAR, GG’S, KICK IN THE BRICK

order_book.title: Order book & pipeline
order_book.body: 65 keys (Dombivli), 50 keys (Indore), 135 keys (Gandhinagar), 40 keys (Bangalore) — all under discussion for closure; 10+ upcoming properties confirmed for Q1–Q2 FY27

guidance.title: Guidance / outlook
guidance.body: Targeting 5,000 keys by 2030; expanding via EBOT™ and management contracts in pilgrimage, wellness, and business corridors; aiming for 25% CAGR in revenue through FY28.

growth_optionality.title: Growth verticals / optionality
growth_optionality.body: Expansion into 15+ new Tier II/III cities via EBOT™ model; potential franchising of 'Satva' vegetarian F&B brands; entry into wellness retreats and pilgrimage corridors; possible spin-off of modular construction arm (Red Ribbon RE Rise India)

margins.title: Margins & cost dynamics
margins.body: EBITDA margin ~20% (FY26); cost advantage from 3D volumetric construction (30% faster build, 20% lower capex); F&B contributes 35% of revenue with 50%+ margins

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation
capital_allocation.body: 70% to new hotel development via EBOT™, 20% to tech/AI integration, 10% to brand expansion (F&B); zero debt, no equity dilution planned; 100% internally funded

risks.title: Risks & watch-items
risks.body: Delays in regulatory approvals for greenfield projects; competition from established chains entering mid-premium segment; supply chain disruptions for modular construction materials; slower-than-expected adoption of vegetarian-only model in non-pilgrimage markets

non_obvious.title: Non-obvious takeaways
non_obvious.body: The company’s 'Satva' vegetarian dining concept is not just a menu choice but a core brand differentiator — aligned with spiritual tourism demand and creating 50%+ F&B margins, effectively turning food into a profit engine rather than a cost center.

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Group structure] Promoted by Eco Hotels UK PLC; ultimate holding entity Red Ribbon Asset Management PLC is a global impact investor (founded 2007) managing £53+ million with 5 funds set to launch, 120+ employees and 8 global offices, active in real estate, direct fintech investments, and fund management, including as exclusive asset manager for the Red Ribbon RE RISE India Real Estate Fund.
- [Advisors] EY LLP serves as Investor Relations advisor for the company (contacts: Pratik Jagtap, Jeevika Kishnani).
- [Filing] Presentation was filed with BSE under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, dated March 10, 2026.
